EVIDENCE & ASSUMPTIONS

01 / INDUSTRY RESEARCH

Adobe · June 2025

Survey of more than 1,600 marketers. 96% reported content demand at least doubling in two years. 56% cited knowing what resonates across platforms as their biggest social-content challenge.

Read the original report ↗
02 / INDUSTRY RESEARCH

Nielsen · May 2025

Survey of 1,400 global marketing professionals with annual marketing budgets of at least US$1 million. 32% reported holistic measurement of both digital and traditional media spending. This sample represents established organizations; it does not establish small-business prevalence.

Read the original report ↗
03 / ILLUSTRATION & PRODUCT STATUS

Assumptions are visible.

The 36-variation example is arithmetic, not measured customer data. Production hours are adjustable assumptions. Journey examples are illustrative. Architecture and workflow improvements describe the proposed product; this presentation does not claim a working campaign integration, validated simulation, customer traction, or measured uplift.

04 / NEXT EVIDENCE TO COLLECT

Validate against an actual baseline.

Interview marketing leads about production and testing capacity. Run a matched-scope pilot and measure time to live test, total cost per experiment, and next-test turnaround. Also track qualified outcomes and creative quality so speed is not mistaken for effectiveness.
